scope: P1.2 maintenance file-authorization policy: unit/boundary evidence only. NOT a GUI approval flow, NOT an OS sandbox, NOT extension activation, and it does not close the TOCTOU window between a permission check and the executor's open/write.
newDesignNotRecoveredOriginal: checkPermission appears 0 times in recovered/shuncode-extension/src/*.ts and the original callback has no operation parameter. The operation-aware contract is new maintenance design.
guarantees: literal true only; false/truthy-non-boolean/throw/reject all deny
grant keyed by owner + tool + operation + realpath
bounded TTL; workspace-roots snapshot change invalidates
revokeOwner for session teardown; close() denies and clears
cancellation checked before and after the host await
knownLimitations: TOCTOU window between check and open remains
grants are cached within TTL because applyPatch runs preflight twice
modern-era owners have no teardown hook and rely on expiry alone
supplying the callback downgrades find/search from ripgrep to the Node walker
native-chat is a fallback constant, not an authenticated subject

initiallySurvived: cache key without operation (test crossed tools, so keys differed anyway)
removed pre-await closed check (masked by the post-await check)
mutationTesting.resolution: Both were test gaps; assertions were strengthened rather than the finding softened.

crossPlatformDefectFoundByCI.symptom: ubuntu-24.04 passed; windows-2022 and windows-cmd-conda failed in npm test.
crossPlatformDefectFoundByCI.cause: Executors realpath() workspace roots before calling checkPermission, but patchPlan was keyed by the host's raw spelling. Windows mkdtemp returns an 8.3 short name that realpath expands, so no key matched and every apply_patch checkpoint was denied.
crossPlatformDefectFoundByCI.fix: canonicalizePatchPlan resolves plan keys like the executors do; case-folded index on win32.
crossPlatformDefectFoundByCI.regressionTest: symlink/junction root case, skipped explicitly where unsupported

releaseGate.why: No host UI approval, no source build entry, no real extension activation.
